body:
Source: GitHub issue #622 (release-audit class false-green, P1-high). Re-verified on main @ 7f45efd5: `packages/flail-detector/bin/flail-detector.mjs:160` records a `flail-check` manifest entry whenever `result.verdict !== 'flail'`, and `analyze()` returns verdict `clean` for a log that produced zero usable lines. `printf '' | flail-detector /dev/stdin --json` prints `{"verdict":"clean","signals":[],"bytes":0}` and exits 0; with `--record --ticket T1` it appends a signed flail-check entry that fully satisfies `PHASE_REQUIREMENTS.p4` in `packages/runner/lib/assertions.mjs` (presence-only check). A supervisor pointed at a log path that was never written gets a green P4 gate and permanent evidence for a session nobody analyzed.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. The package is `packages/flail-detector` (bin/flail-detector.mjs, lib/{parse-log,analyze,signals,format}.mjs, tests in test/*.test.mjs run with `npm test -w packages/flail-detector`). `parseLog(raw)` returns `{ lines, bytes }`; `analyze({ lines, bytes, scopes, maxRepeat, maxBytes, spentTokens, budget })` returns `{ verdict: 'clean'|'flail', signals, bytes, ... }`. The scope-violation and edit-churn signals key off file paths extracted from lines by the extractor in lib/signals.mjs. Exit codes today: 0 clean, 1 operational error, 2 flail.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Add a third outcome, `could-not-analyze`, decided by ONE exported pure function in lib (suggested: `assessAnalyzability({ lines, scopes, extractedPaths })` in lib/analyze.mjs, or a new lib/analyzability.mjs) that returns `{ ok: true }` or `{ ok: false, reasons: string[] }`. It is not-ok when the parsed log has zero non-empty lines (empty or whitespace-only file). Scope is NOT part of the decision: a supervisor (e.g. @adlc/fleet, packages/fleet/lib/gates.mjs checkFlail) passes the ticket's --scope on EVERY consult and a well-behaved session may contain no writes at all, so a log with lines but no extractable file path is analyzed normally (repeated-error/size/budget signals still fire; the scope signals simply have nothing to flag). Path under-extraction is #623's domain — no new output field for it.
2. The CLI calls that function after parseLog and before analyze/record. When it is not-ok: text mode prints `flail-detector: could not analyze — <reason>; <reason>` to stderr; `--json` prints exactly one JSON document to stdout `{ "verdict": "could-not-analyze", "reasons": [...], "bytes": <n>, "signals": [] }`; NO manifest entry is appended even when `--record` is given; exit code is 1 (operational). Exit 2 stays reserved for real flail signals and exit 0 for a genuinely analyzed clean log.
3. Regression guard: a non-empty log with no signals still reports CLEAN, exits 0, and with `--record` still appends the flail-check entry exactly as today.
4. Documentation: update the Exit Codes / verdict sections of `packages/flail-detector/README.md`, and make the SAME edit by hand in the two mirrors `docs/tools/flail-detector.md` and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/flail-detector.mdx` (they are hand-maintained mirrors — never regenerate them).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (each with its verification method).
- AC1 An empty log file: `node packages/flail-detector/bin/flail-detector.mjs <empty.log>` exits 1 and stderr contains `could not analyze`. verify: `node --test packages/flail-detector/test/could-not-analyze.test.mjs`
- AC2 A whitespace-only log with `--json` prints a single JSON document whose `verdict` is `could-not-analyze` with a non-empty `reasons` array, exits 1. verify: `node --test packages/flail-detector/test/could-not-analyze.test.mjs`
- AC3 (regression pin) `--scope 'src/**'` on `all good\nbuild succeeded\n` (lines, no extractable path) is CLEAN exit 0, and `error: boom\nerror: boom\n` with `--scope` is FLAIL exit 2 — --scope never turns a clean or flailing session into could-not-analyze. verify: `node --test packages/flail-detector/test/could-not-analyze.test.mjs` and the consumer tests `node --test packages/fleet/test/flail-contract.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/flail-e2e.test.mjs`
- AC4 `--record --ticket T1` on an empty log appends nothing to the manifest (use an isolated ADLC_DIR temp dir the way test/record.test.mjs does and assert the ledger is unchanged). verify: `node --test packages/flail-detector/test/could-not-analyze.test.mjs`
- AC5 A non-empty log with no signals is CLEAN exit 0 and `--record` still appends a flail-check entry (existing tests stay green; if an existing test pins the vacuous-CLEAN behaviour, update it and say so in the PR body). verify: `npm test -w packages/flail-detector`
- AC6 The decision function is unit-tested directly for both reasons and for the ok case. verify: `node --test packages/flail-detector/test/could-not-analyze.test.mjs`
- AC7 Docs updated in all three places. verify: `grep -c "could-not-analyze" packages/flail-detector/README.md docs/tools/flail-detector.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/flail-detector.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC8 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: #623 (path extraction anchored to line start) — do not rewrite the extractor and do not treat scope-vacuity as could-not-analyze (that fails supervisors OPEN on every normal session).

PROCESS (ADLC). Work only in your assigned worktree. P3: the rails on this ticket are frozen — if the fix appears to require editing a rail path, STOP and report; never set ADLC_RAILS_BYPASS. P4: TDD — write test/could-not-analyze.test.mjs first, run it RED, then implement. P5 before opening the PR: `npm test -w packages/flail-detector`, `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` (exit 0), then `npx adversarial-review --base origin/main --provider codex --timeout 600` and loop review→fix→re-review until exit 0 with ZERO findings and no warning lines (read findings[] every round; exit 0 alone is not the signal). Do not add gate-manifest entries. Keep the diff to packages/flail-detector/**, the three docs files, and this ticket's shard. PR title `fix(flail-detector): ...`, body must contain `Closes #622`.
title: flail-detector: report could-not-analyze (exit 1) for an empty/unusable log instead of CLEAN, and never record it as P4 evidence
